# Universal Mouse Drivers (UMD)

> Browser-native WebHID mouse drivers and a Windows battery tray for Redragon King Ultra (and expanding device support).

## Site
- Home (PL): https://umd.skullmedia.pl/pl
- Home (EN): https://umd.skullmedia.pl/en
- Sitemap: https://umd.skullmedia.pl/sitemap.xml

## Product
- WebHID configuration in Chrome/Edge (no OEM installer required)
- Device pages: sensor/DPI, button mapping, settings (sleep, firmware), macros (soon)
- Companion Windows tray app for battery status and startup integration

## Key pages
- /pl — connect & product entry
- /pl/device/sensor — DPI, polling, LOD, Peak
- /pl/device/buttons — button remapping
- /pl/device/settings — firmware, sleep mode, tray
- /pl/device/macro — macros (coming soon)
- English mirrors under /en/...
